title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
summary: Daily calendar for the Valdena Gelato shop, one row per day with a calendar_date, an is_open flag and a free-text event_name for any local event. Catalog coverage starts 2022-01-01 and is open-ended, refreshed weekly (last refresh 2026-10-10), so it spans both the history and recent windows. The catalog lists about 1500 rows, which is below the roughly 1744 calendar days from 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-10, so completeness is unverified.

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Local event that day, if any

schema.notes: Schema taken from catalog entry only. No sample was read, so value sets and nulls are unchecked. No wiki page describes this table.

spatial.code_system: free-text event names; no location within town
spatial.notes: Shop-level calendar for a single shop in northern Italy. Event locations are not recorded.

access.request_process: Open to analytics roles (catalog entry store.calendar). Role membership not verified.

quality_notes: Row count mismatch: catalog row_count_approx 1500 vs about 1744 calendar days from 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-10 (about 1749 to the as_of date 2026-10-15). Roughly 244 days may be missing, or the count is stale. Not verified; no sample read.
Candidate note said roughly 1600 days from 2022 to 2026. That figure is lower than the calendar count, so the gap is larger than the candidate stated.

Possible link to the till outage: wiki page till_migration_2024 (owner Retail Operations, last edited 2024-03-12) says no sales were recorded 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 because the till was replaced, and to treat those days as missing, not zero. It does not say whether the calendar marks those days is_open = false. The calendar's is_open for that period is unknown, so it could wrongly read as closed days.
No wiki page documents this table (wiki_backlinks empty). Catalog description is the only documentation; semantics of is_open for partial days, holidays or outages are not documented.
event_name is free text with no code list, and no location within town is recorded.
